stem: A canopy review uses only one center-room photograph to claim uniform recovery after work. What evidence would most improve the conclusion?
choices: A second center-room photograph from the same angle.
The name of the training technique alone.
Repeatable mapped observations across predefined canopy positions linked to the authorized work and recovery timing.
Fixture wattage without spatial crop observations.
rationale: Repeatable mapped observations across predefined canopy positions linked to the authorized work and recovery timing.
